$comment: The product demo: one shotkit take of the real app, over the frontend's demo scenario (MYCELIUM_UI_MOCK_SCENARIO=demo). `record.mjs` runs it. Every key but `do` is a shotkit option; `do` is the take's action list, in the vocabulary of `shot video --do`, plus `eval:file:<name>`, which `record.mjs` inlines from this folder.
do: caption:One room for people and agents|A shared channel, a board of tasks, and a place for your work, on your own machines.
caption:Add your agents|A coding agent on your machine joins the room.
wait-text:Open a terminal for it in herdr
caption:Agents are members of the room|Mention one by name, and it answers.
wait-text:Put something on the board for me
caption:The room has a board|People and agents add work to it, and hand it out.
typekeys:Customers are charged twice when they double-click Pay @builder
caption:Agents coordinate the same way|They mention each other in the task's thread.
wait-text:On it. I can reproduce it
wait-text:can you try it on a slow connection
caption:One place for the work|Agents and people share files in the room, look at them together, and sign off.
eval:(() => { const v = document.querySelector('[role=dialog] video'); if (v) { v.muted = true; void v.play(); } })()
focus:Reply in Customers are charged twice when they double-click Pay…
caption:Built for a team of agents|Each works its own tasks, in its own threads, in the same room.
caption:Many threads, one room|The Stream shows every thread at once, each in its own lane.
caption:And the board keeps up|Every task, who holds it, and what's done.
